evidence.quote: CALA courses for students starting in Münster are held in German (70%), English (20%), and Spanish/Portuguese (10%).
The following is valid for applicants from: all countries For the winter semester: 15 February - 31 May

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states tuition fees per semester are None, but a semester contribution of approx. 300 EUR is mentioned; no separate international fee is given. Application deadlines: the page gives "15 February - 31 May" for applicants from all countries without a year, so it is stored as recurringDeadline; no explicit non-EU-only deadline is stated. applicationChannel: the pages do not mention uni-assist or a direct application portal, so no channel could be quoted; "Submit application via Please check this website." names no platform. Teaching languages: the German/English/Spanish mix applies to students starting in Münster; Spanish/Portuguese is also used at partner universities in Latin America. The second page (fh-muenster.de) contains no usable content.
